in_arabic.name: لطيفة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم لطيفة مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ل-ط-ف، ويعني اللطيفة الرقيقة الحساسة. وردت هذه المعاني في القرآن الكريم في سياق وصف الله تعالى بأنه لطيف بعباده.

in_urdu.name: لطیفہ
in_urdu.meaning: لطیفہ یعنی نرم دل حساس خوبصورت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام لطیفہ عربی جڑ ل-ط-ف سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نرم دل، حساس اور خوبصورت۔ اردو میں اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں شائع ہے، جو اس کی خوبصورتی اور روحانی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: लतिफा
in_hindi.meaning: लतिफा का अर्थ है सुंदर और कोमल हृदय
in_hindi.long_meaning: लतिफा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर, कोमल हृदय और संवेदनशील। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का उपयोग पारंपरिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: لطيفه
in_pashto.meaning: لطيفه دى نرم زړه او حساسه ښځه
in_pashto.long_meaning: د لطيفه نوم مانع دى د نرم زړه او حساسه ښځه. په پښتو کلتور کې، دا نوم د ښځو لپاره کارول کېږي چې نرم او مهربانه وي.

in_english.name: Latifaah
in_english.meaning: Latifaah means delicate, sensitive, and kind-hearted
in_english.long_meaning: The name Latifaah originates from the Arabic root 'l-ṭ-f', signifying delicate, sensitive, and kind-hearted. In Islamic tradition, this name reflects the attributes of Allah, emphasizing His gentle and merciful nature. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing beauty, compassion, and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Latifaah holds a special place in Islamic culture as it signifies the values of compassion, kindness, and gentleness. These values are highly emphasized in Islamic teachings and are encouraged in everyday life. The name Latifaah is a reminder of the beauty and grace found in being considerate, compassionate, and kind towards others.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Latifaah carries a deeper meaning. It reminds us of Allah's infinite mercy and kindness towards His creation. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "Allah is gentle and loves gentleness." (Bukhari and Muslim). By being Latifaah, we strive to embody Allah's mercy and kindness in our interactions with others, reflecting the divine attributes within ourselves.

historical_references.reference: Latifaah bint Abdullah ibn Ja'far (d. 710) was a granddaughter of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq and a sister of Imam Isma'il al-Mubarak. She is known for her piety and her devotion to the Prophet Muhammad.
